svg.title: Enterprise product catalog search on AWS
svg.text: Enterprise product catalog search on AWS

Hybrid keyword + semantic search over a product catalog: a cached edge, a thin search API, OpenSearch for retrieval, Bedrock embeddings for meaning, and an event-driven pipeline that keeps the index fresh
